---
title: "Claude Code + Claude"
---

([Back to the choices](setup.qmd).)

**Subscribe to Claude Pro.** Go to [claude.ai](https://claude.ai) and sign up (or log in). Click your name in the lower-left corner > *Upgrade plan* > *Pro*.

**Install Claude Code.** Paste the block into PowerShell (Windows) or Terminal (Mac).

**On Windows**:

```powershell
irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```

**On Mac**:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
```

If the installer prints a command that adds a folder to your PATH, run that command too.

**Log in.** Open a new terminal window and run `claude`. Choose *Claude account with subscription*, log in to your Pro account in the browser window that opens, and click *Authorize*. Quit with `/exit`.

**Check.** Run

```sh
claude -p --model haiku "Reply with only the word hello."
```

It should print `hello`. Then go to [A First Example](first-example.qmd).
